attributes.action: Ban fireworks from all private sales.  Displays should be community events only
attributes.additional_details: The private sales of fireworks should be banned completely and firework displays should be Community organised events only.  Housing developments are built without space between houses and gardens are tiny making it unsafe to let off fireworks. Plus the disturbance to dogs/pets is too disturbing

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
